title: phedimus litoralis
intro: Phedimus litoralis, commonly known as Rock Sea Cress, is a perennial plant species in the saxifrage family. This succulent plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phedimus litoralis include acting as an anti-inflammatory agent, which helps to soothe and calm irritated skin, as well as its ability to promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
